Workflow: QUBO mapping -> Q-CTRL Fire Opal SDK (solve_qaoa)
Remarks: Optimal solution found during 16 iterations with 8192 shots. Production solver applied directly: no tuning or graph preprocessing. CPU runtime includes optimised layout selection, depth reduction and other error suppression techniques from Q-CTRL Fire Opal. These techniques can be computationally intensive for large circuits, but are critical to extract quantum signal. Solver available via Qiskit https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/docs/en/guides/q-ctrl-optimization-solver
